foundation_name: Evidence-Bound Vertical AI Validation Foundation V1
responsibility: Design evidence-to-validation Vertical AI capacity that verifies contracts, boundaries, and results without mutating Platform Core or CIL

components.name: Validation Context
components.responsibility: Assemble a read-only validation context from execution runtime outputs, Platform Core, CIL, Repository Intelligence, and certified connector snapshots.

components.name: Validation Selector
components.responsibility: Select which execution results, contracts, and boundaries to validate using repository-first, evidence-first priority; never invents unauthorized writes.

components.name: Validation Rules
components.responsibility: Declare reusable, deterministic validation rules for contracts, boundaries, reuse-before-create, and result integrity without owning source data.

components.name: Contract Validation
components.responsibility: Validate conformance to certified Platform Core, CIL, connector, and Vertical AI contracts cited by execution outputs.

components.name: Boundary Validation
components.responsibility: Validate that certified execution boundaries remain intact: no PC/CIL mutation, certified connectors only, write authorization blocked.

components.name: Result Validation
components.responsibility: Validate execution result fingerprints for reproducibility, determinism, and evidence precedence before any approval or runtime handoff.

components.name: Validation Evidence
components.responsibility: Bind fingerprints and refs so every validation conclusion is preceded by execution and planning evidence.

components.name: Validation Traceability
components.responsibility: Maintain evidence-to-validation traceability from execution outputs through rules, contract/boundary/result checks, and approval readiness.

components.name: Validation Reproducibility
components.responsibility: Ensure identical evidence and execution inputs yield identical validation design fingerprints across dual runs.

components.name: Validation Contract
components.responsibility: Declare the validation boundary contract: consumes PC/CIL/RI/certified connectors/execution runtime only; forbids PC/CIL mutation and unapproved repository mutation.

components.name: Validation Runtime Reference
components.responsibility: Reference the certified surfaces future Validation Runtime will bind (execution runtime, Agent Runtime, CIL); reference-only, no mutation.

components.name: Approval Gate
components.responsibility: Require explicit human approval before any repository mutation that validation might later recommend; foundation runs remain read-only.

components.name: Validation Boundary Integrity
components.responsibility: Codify and design integrity checks for certified validation boundaries across Platform Core, CIL, connectors, and repository mutation gates.
